findings.effect: vt_upgrade_supported_for_downgraded_rtt_call (CarrierConfigManager.java:3443-3447, default true at :12199) is meant to decide whether a call that was an RTT call and was downgraded may be upgraded to video. On this ROM and stack nothing reads it. Outside its definition in CarrierConfigManager there is no reference to the key string or its constant in frameworks/, frameworks/opt/telephony, frameworks/opt/net/ims, packages/services/Telephony, packages/services/Telecomm, packages/apps/Dialer, packages/modules/ImsStack (tree and OCD fork branch ocd), vendor/, device/, hardware/ or lineage-sdk. The ImsStack's list of carrier-config keys forwarded to the native stack does not include it (CarrierConfig.java:62-90). Serving false therefore changes no call. Read on the 23.2 tree; the phone runs 24.0, where readers were not checked.
findings.risk: None on this ROM and stack, because no code reads the key. If a later ROM or ImsStack starts reading it, false would only withhold the upgrade offer for a call that was downgraded before. It would never affect how a call, emergency included, is placed, routed, held or called back, and it matches the Verizon and Google settings for these SIMs.
